AI Semiconductor Supply Chain Pricing PowerAI半导体供应链定价权
×12 · 43 steps
Hyperscaler AI compute demand is generating structural supply tightness and pricing power. Component shortages and extended lead times are driving customers to place orders far in advance, with FANUC total orders growing 37% YoY and FA orders +64% YoY, and all four US hyperscalers highlighting ongoing capacity constraints. Hyperscalers are raising capex to absorb rising component costs, with capital intensity approaching 35% consensus. Apple warns of supply constraints and increasing costs for components, and FANUC expects lead times to normalize over 1-2 quarters. Book-to-bill remains well above 1, with customers ordering out to 2027-2028.

China consumer K-shape bifurcation中国消费K型分化
×8 · 36 steps
Chinese consumer demand is sharply K-shaped: domestic demand softening while exports remain resilient, prompting the Politburo to signal faster fiscal spending and potential supplementary budget of up to Rmb1trn; analysts expect additional easing if July-August growth disappoints, with Rmb2trn of unused fiscal impulse available and Rmb7.5trn quota left for 2H26.
43 extracted · 8 firms
Consensus·8 firms·43 extracted·As of 2026-08-04
Chinese consumer demand is sharply K-shaped, with premium spending stable while mass-market softens, prompting expectations of policy easing.中国消费需求呈现K型分化，高端消费稳定而大众市场疲软，引发政策宽松预期。
Analysts largely agree on the K-shaped bifurcation but differ on the scale and effectiveness of fiscal stimulus.分析师普遍认同K型分化，但对财政刺激的规模和效果存在分歧。

LNG transit via the Strait of Hormuz remains halted, with Qatar's liquefaction capacity averaging near 13% on a 7DMA basis.

China property downcycle with selective SOE alpha中国地产下行周期与国企个股Alpha
×7 · 26 steps
China property activity indicators are down 60-80% from 2020-21 peaks. Despite top-100 developer sales falling -9% YoY in July 2026 (steepest since April), SOE developers' aggregate sales turned positive from -1% YoY in June to +3% YoY in July, driven by COLI (+27%), CR Land (+26%), Jinmao (+9%), with these three named as top picks and their shares outperforming HSI (+13%, +26%, +14% YTD).

The late-July Politburo signaled policy continuity with 'more proactive fiscal' and 'moderately accommodative monetary' stance, but priorities remain AI+, advanced manufacturing, basic research, and Six Networks rather than broad consumer transfers. AI compute infrastructure supply strainAI 算力基建供给紧张
×6 · 26 steps
Multiple reports document accelerating AI infrastructure demand from hyperscalers and neoclouds that is straining power, GPU, and component supply (power-constrained colocation, AI-server MLCC tightness, liquid cooling), strengthening pricing power and creating new monetization paths. Equinix's interconnection revenue grew 9% YoY to $453M, with record net additions of 9,700; implied market share has fallen from ~8% to ~5% but is course-correcting with rapid cabinet brings online.
9 extracted · 6 firms

Goldman SachsMorgan Stanley
Grid electrification capex super-cycle电网电气化资本开支超级周期
×2 · 10 steps
Morgan Stanley frames an Investment Super Cycle with Asia Pacific energy security investment sized at US$5trn total (US$1.2trn incremental by 2030, US$9trn total value creation of which US$2.3trn renewable, US$1.7trn power grids, US$0.9trn other) and separately argues Huaming's earnings growth accelerates from 11-16% in 2024-26 to 18-20% pa in 2027-29E driven by domestic grid capex, global market-share gain and UHV products, with EU electrification targets lifting the rate from a stagnant 23% to 46% by 2040. Schneider delivered 2Q26 group organic sales growth of +16.5%, outpacing ABB at +12%, driven by a stronger Industrial Automation performance. Hitachi Energy orders rose 87% yoy including nuclear and 94% yoy excluding nuclear, with order backlog reaching ¥10.3tn (+12% from end-FY3/26) / US$63.6bn (+10%) and sales growth running over 20% on a USD basis versus Hitachi's initial high-teens assumption; Hitachi expects Energy profit margins to continue improving via better margins on the order backlog, AI utilization, full-scale ERP contribution, and improved project management. US power transformer demand-local supply gap narrows from 72% to 57% by 2028E against persistent 128-week global lead times, with Chinese 10-220MVA transformer ASPs up 5x yoy and Chinese power transformer exports to the US surged +172% yoy in June 2026 (US transformer PPI +3.9% yoy).

Nomura4 steps
  1. 1
    Premise全球CPO产量停滞或下降
    ~85 %
    Global crude palm oil (CPO) production is either going to be stagnant or decline in the medium term, even without the Middle East war disruption, as plantation age profile is heavily skewed towards older trees in Indonesia and Malaysia (which together account for ~85% of global CPO production).
    ad0a65a77207·《Indonesia CPO: Supercycle zone – Continued inventory depletion to boost CPO prices》·2026-07-28
  2. 2
    Mechanism印尼再植缓慢限制供给
    45 %
    Indonesia has been too slow in replanting smallholder plantations (45% of Indonesia's total plantation area); accumulated area to rejuvenate would incur massive cost, and there is a shortage of quality palm oil seeds, suggesting long-term production yield pressure unless the government reopens large new plantation areas.
    ad0a65a77207·《Indonesia CPO: Supercycle zone – Continued inventory depletion to boost CPO prices》·2026-07-28
  3. 3
    Mechanism生物柴油需求推升价格
    >65 %；~4 mn tons；~4.7 mn tons
    Indonesia's biodiesel program has historically contributed >65% of global incremental CPO demand (according to USDA); B50 implementation will add ~4mn tons of demand (vs. 4.7mn tons estimated global demand in 2026F and 2027F), likely pushing CPO prices to new highs.
    ad0a65a77207·《Indonesia CPO: Supercycle zone – Continued inventory depletion to boost CPO prices》·2026-07-28
  4. 4
    Conclusion多重因素利好CPO价格
    Disruptions in fertilizer prices, biodiesel expansion + levy hike, and El Nino trend are likely to have a positive impact on CPO price movements as well as benefit CPO firms' earnings; every time ther
    Disruptions in fertilizer prices, biodiesel expansion + levy hike, and El Nino trend are likely to have a positive impact on CPO price movements as well as benefit CPO firms' earnings; every time there was a substantial adjustment in levy prices during 2019-25 or a spike in fertilizer prices during 2021-22, CPO firms' EBIT margins remained stable or even kept expanding.
    ad0a65a77207·《Indonesia CPO: Supercycle zone – Continued inventory depletion to boost CPO prices》·2026-07-28
